ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; record the driver's "I'm Here" tap made ~1000 m from the pickup point as abuse of the arrival/waiting button and send the driver account for review; no driver waiting-fee payout ($4.50) is due.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited >3 min at the pickup is contradicted by system records: closest approach 868 m (F1), stationary 993 m away (F2), never recorded at pickup (F4), and 0 s within 200 m after the tap (F5).
Timeline entry asserting the driver never tapped 'I'm Here' conflicts with the timestamped tap event in F5; the case does not turn on this element because NS-1 (ii) and (iii) already fail.
Rider's prior upheld no-show disputes cannot support the charge; profile facts never decide a case (procedure) and are irrelevant given the GPS failure.
